NUMBERS - REPLAY KEYS AND TIMING
SANYALnet Labs  |  Spectrum 60  |  Program 21

We recorded these input events during a real FUSE demonstration.
The times are measured from the start of the FUSE runner, in seconds.
They are not timings from the Spectrum's internal clock. That little
computer has enough to do without keeping our stopwatch.

REPRODUCE THE RUN
From this program folder, enter: sh ./REPLAY.sh.
On a Linux host, the package runner uses FUSE, Xvfb, Python 3,
python-xlib, and Pillow. New pictures go to REPLAYS/21-numbers/ at the
collection root; they do not replace the selected images automatically.

Main capture session: v19-finish/21-numbers
Emulator speed: 230%
Recorded ordered script: K:1|K:Return|L:XIV|C:roman-conversion

SCRIPT ACTIONS IN PLAIN ENGLISH
  01. Tap 1.
  02. Tap Return.
  03. Type XIV and press Enter.
  04. Save a screen named roman-conversion.

EXACT INPUT EVENTS
The following events preserve the X11 key names and timings recorded
in the session, including keys needed to type LOAD and RUN. These events
are listed to make the session repeatable, not as game instructions.

The pictured files are genuine FUSE captures from the sessions named
above. When a selected frame comes from another session, its source is
stated explicitly. A replay may show different random positions or
slightly different timing. We record what happened, not what we hoped
would happen.
